Placemaker.Waterfront.Name: Waterfront
Placemaker.Recipe.Waterfront.Description: A promenade along the water's edge: railings, lamps and benches facing the water, steps down, piers, kiosks and a tree row.
Placemaker.Waterfront.style.Tooltip: Promenade, pier & boardwalk, harbor walk, river steps or fishing spot.
Placemaker.Waterfront.waterSide.Tooltip: Which side of the area faces the water. Automatic finds the water; otherwise pick a side (north = +Z on the map).
Placemaker.Waterfront.promWidth.Tooltip: Depth of the promenade from the water's edge. From about 11 m benches fit between the edge and the walk.
Placemaker.Waterfront.railings.Tooltip: Railings along the edge, open where steps and piers meet it.
Placemaker.Waterfront.lampSpacing.Toolti: Lamps along the water side of the walk. 0 = none.
Placemaker.Waterfront.moorings.Tooltip: Bollards along the quay edge, as in a harbor.
Placemaker.Waterfront.riprap.Tooltip: Rocks along the waterline (riprap), for a natural bank.
Placemaker.Waterfront.steps.Tooltip: Stepped terraces down towards the water (permanent terrain change): a few spots, or along the whole edge like river ghats.
Placemaker.Waterfront.stepLevels.Tooltip: Number of terraces, each 1.5 m deep.
Placemaker.Waterfront.piers.Tooltip: Piers built as paths out over the water. Draw the area out over the water to get them.
Placemaker.Waterfront.pierHeads.Tooltip: A cross walk at the end of each pier.
Placemaker.Waterfront.fishing.Tooltip: Spots along the edge with fishing props, a seat and a bin.
Placemaker.Waterfront.nautical.Tooltip: Life rings by the edge, anchors, buoys and crates along the walk.
Placemaker.Waterfront.trees.Tooltip: A tree row, or a double row (avenue), behind the promenade.
Placemaker.Waterfront.backdrop.Tooltip: What fills the land behind the promenade: a lawn, a planted park, or nothing.
Placemaker.Waterfront.shopLayout.Tooltip: A continuous band along the street, or separate shop pads.
Placemaker.Waterfront.shopDepth.Tooltip: How deep the zoned band reaches into the area (whole 8 m cells).
Placemaker.Waterfront.Issue.PiersNeedWat: Piers need water inside the area: draw the outline out over the water.
